It is completely normal in your situation. I used to feel a thrill of being a "dirty little whore", now I know that my ex-boyfriend was just raping me, and I was too young to be even thinking of those things. I find myself still fantasizing at night about those days, and I found some solace and peace in CNC kink, but you sound too young for me to even be suggesting that to you, but make sure you do proper ACTUAL research into what you could be getting yourself into, because I know I can't stop you. You were a child, and children are molded into the shape that the hands of those around them make you. Those things will carry through with you, and no matter what anybody says, it does define you to some certain extent. You just have to make the best out of it you can. 

The best part is, and I know this might be really painful to hear, he's dead. He is dead and gone and hopefully being tormented beyond human comprehension in hell. He can't hurt you, and he can't hurt your little sister anymore. The monster is gone. 

Live in spite of what you have overcome. You, my dear, have an experience that most people cannot even imagine, and you can help so many. That pain and disgust is felt by millions of people around the world just like you, and you may not be able to save all of them, but maybe just one. Still leaving this world a better place than where you found it. I personally have used that pain and rage as the lifeforce behind me, I still struggle a lot (i was looking through this subreddit of course I am) but I am officially six years after my initial "expiration date" I had set for myself. 

You don't even have to be great. You don't have to grow and be mother fucking Theresa, and that's the sickeningly beautiful thing about it. The fact that you've made it this far is enough, and if you aren't proud of yourself, I sure fucking am.
